processing: Decompressed the original Zstandard and SARC containers.
Converted the original BFRES meshes, skinning and BNTX textures into glTF.
Restored BFRES Euler radians in ZYX order; retained bone names and original topology.
Combined original body and clothing; embedded all used textures.
Lowered the arms into a relaxed pose without rebinding; normalized each model to its recorded height and feet to y=0.
converter.texturePolicy: Original base-color maps are used. No generated or placeholder textures.
